gloss: to make a habit of; to habituate; to train oneself to do

definitions.gloss: to make a habit of; to habituate; to train (someone/oneself) to do something regularly
definitions.explanation: To deliberately establish a behavior as a regular routine, either for oneself or for someone else, through repeated practice.

examples.japanese: ⟦{早起|はやお}き→早起き：02477_hayaoki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{習慣付|しゅうかんづ}ける。
examples.english: To make a habit of waking up early.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{手洗|てあら}い→手洗い：12761_tearai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{習慣付|しゅうかんづ}けた。
examples.english: I trained my child to make hand washing a habit.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦ずつ→〜ずつ：03092_zutsu⟧で⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{運動|うんどう}→運動：00821_undou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{習慣付|しゅうかんづ}けること⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: It is important to make a habit of exercising a little every day.

notes:
A compound verb from ⟦{習慣|しゅうかん}→習慣：01429_shuukan⟧ (habit, custom) and {付|づ}ける (to attach, to apply). Means to establish something as a regular habit, either for oneself or for others. Often used in contexts of child-rearing, health, and self-improvement.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{早起|はやお}き→早起き：02477_hayaoki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{習慣付|しゅうかんづ}ける: to make early rising a habit
- ⟦{運動|うんどう}→運動：00821_undou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{習慣付|しゅうかんづ}ける: to make exercise a habit
- ⟦{読書|どくしょ}→読書：03484_dokusho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{習慣付|しゅうかんづ}ける: to make reading a habit
- {子|こ}ども⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{習慣付|しゅうかんづ}ける: to instill a habit in children

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{身|み}→身：01764_mi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{付|つ}ける→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧: to acquire (a skill, habit) — broader; not limited to habits
- ⟦{慣|な}れる→慣れる：00870_nareru⟧: to get used to — passive process of becoming accustomed rather than deliberate habit formation
- ⟦{癖|くせ}→癖：03814_kuse⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to make into a habit — more colloquial; can be positive or negative
